name: Fieldcraft
description: Four distinct fictional equipment challenges: interference crossing, two-dock emitter suppression, pulse recovery and net-assisted capture. Every class stays selectable; briefs recommend tools without inventing ability gates.

classRecipes.label: Scout
classRecipes.description: Mark hidden objectives permanently; show enemy direction hints for four seconds. No slowing.

classRecipes.label: Light carrier
classRecipes.description: Pick up one charge at a supply pad; drop a field that stuns nearby field enemies.

classRecipes.label: Heavy carrier
classRecipes.description: Carry two charges; each creates the same temporary stun field.

classRecipes.label: Interceptor
classRecipes.description: Absorb one enemy or lane contact: cancel the cut and recover at spawn without losing a life. Self-crossing remains dangerous.

classRecipes.label: Fiber relay
classRecipes.description: Ignore signal interference and scan for hidden relays. Your cable is the live trail: enemy contact still breaks it.

classRecipes.label: Impact craft
classRecipes.description: Release a close-range stun pulse, abandon the unfinished cut and redeploy at home without losing a life. The pulse never captures territory.

classRecipes.label: Trapper
classRecipes.description: Pick up one charge and place a four-second field that slows field enemies to one quarter speed.

metadata.description: Recommended: Fiber relay. The amber band spans the entire field: fiber crosses at full speed, while other craft can take slower cuts or build safe launch lines. First split the field vertically; the two relays then favor cuts at different heights. Fiber still has a vulnerable live cable and a 36-cell limit.

Recommended: Light carrier. Collect at the west supply, enter one cell and drop a field beside the emitter before crossing. At the south hangar, try Heavy carrier and collect again: changing craft preserves ammunition and cooldowns. Fields suppress an emitter only while their radius covers its center. Restore both relays with separate cuts.

Recommended: Impact craft. The nearby roamer threatens a cut from the top. Pulse before it touches your cable: the cut is abandoned and the craft redeploys without losing a life. The pulse also holds nearby enemies and suppresses the emitter briefly. Recover at home, then choose a safer cross-field cut from the left rail. This is an escape tool; the pulse never claims territory.

Recommended: Trapper. Pick up a charge before leaving home. Place a net near the fast roamer as you begin the vertical cut; slowing it buys time to close your line. The roamer is still dangerous inside a net. Use the new center rail for a shorter second cut toward the lower relay. Keep every cable within 36 cells and four seconds.
